name: ROWLAND, the Hon. Michelle Anne

headline.note: Official sources establish supermarket, NRMA and Gilbert + Tobin employment, political staff work and several overlapping public or nonprofit governance appointments. They do not provide exact employment dates, substantive hours, leave or breaks. Study, political staff, governance appointments and elected office are excluded, and no private full-time years are inferred from year-only ranges or the senior-lawyer title.

career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records all three University of Sydney qualifications, and Rowland says she was studying law there in 1990. Degree commencement and completion dates, study loads and overlap with paid work remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official occupation record gives 1987–1995. Rowland identifies a supermarket in Blacktown and says she worked as a checkout operator for eight years, including while studying. The supermarket, exact dates, hours, leave and study overlap are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: The work is private-sector employment, but the unidentified employer, year-only dates and missing hours prevent a full-time duration calculation.

career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament records electorate-officer work from 1995 to 1999, and Rowland later described it as one of her first and most important roles. The officeholder, jurisdiction, appointment dates, payroll title, hours and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political-staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary and ministerial biographies identify NRMA Ltd and the 1999–2000 range. Exact dates, business unit, hours, leave and overlap with electorate-office work or legal admission are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: The private employer is identified, but year-only dates and missing full-time evidence prevent an exact duration calculation.

career_spells.role: Senior lawyer specialising in competition and regulation in telecommunications, media and technology
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies record senior-lawyer employment from 2000 to 2010, and member and professional sources identify the competition and communications practice. The House election date is only an upper boundary and does not prove employment continued until 21 August 2010. Exact appointment, promotion and cessation dates, substantive hours, leave and campaign overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is well supported, but a senior title and year-only range do not prove full-time status or an exact interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official sources record the state health-service directorship from 2000 to 2004, overlapping Gilbert + Tobin. Appointment days, remuneration, workload and attendance are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: This governance appointment is visible but excluded from full-time employment totals; a director title does not establish substantive full-time work.

career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament and the Attorney-General's biography record councillor service from 2004 to 2008 and deputy-mayoral service from 2007 to 2008. Exact election and cessation days, allowances, workload and overlap with legal work are not established in the cited sources.
career_spells.counting_note: Local elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies record a non-executive directorship from 2007 to 2010, overlapping legal practice and council service. Exact appointment dates, remuneration, meeting workload and cessation are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The non-executive public governance role is excluded from full-time employment totals.

career_spells.employer: Our Lady of Mercy College Parramatta
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies record the school directorship from 2008 to 2010. Exact appointment dates, legal entity, pay, workload and cessation are unresolved, and the role overlaps legal practice and other governance work.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit governance is excluded; the director title does not establish substantive paid full-time employment.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official sources record the chair appointment from 2009 to 2010. Screen NSW identifies itself as the NSW Government screen agency. Exact appointment dates, remuneration, workload and cessation are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Public-sector governance is excluded from full-time employment totals absent evidence of a substantive employment appointment.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Greenway
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current official biographies establish continuous House service from the 21 August 2010 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: Identify the Blacktown supermarket and obtain exact appointment/cessation dates, hours and leave; resolve how checkout work overlapped University of Sydney study.
Identify the employing parliamentarian and jurisdiction for the 1995–1999 electorate-officer role and obtain appointment dates, payroll title, hours and leave.

Obtain NRMA and Gilbert + Tobin employment records with exact dates, substantive hours, leave, promotions and 2010 campaign overlap; do not infer full-time status from the senior-lawyer title or ten-year narrative.

Obtain appointment instruments, remuneration and workloads for the Western Sydney Area Health Service, Western Sydney Parklands Trust, Our Lady of Mercy College and Screen NSW governance roles, plus exact Blacktown council dates. Missing evidence is not zero, and overlapping directorships must not be summed as full-time years.
